task1.title: Number of jobs in four sectors of the economy in the US, 1960–2020
task1.prompt: The graph below gives information about the number of jobs in four sectors of the economy in the US between 1960 and 2020.

chartDesc.title: Number of jobs in four sectors of the economy in the US, 1960-2020
chartDesc.overview: Healthcare and Retail grew substantially over the 60-year period to become the largest employment sectors by 2020, whereas Manufacturing declined after peaking in 1980 and Agriculture consistently dropped to become the lowest.
keyFeatures: Manufacturing started as the largest sector in 1960 (15 million), peaked at 20 million in 1980, and fell to 13 million by 2020.
Healthcare saw the largest overall rise, increasing eightfold from 2 million in 1960 to 16 million in 2020.
Retail grew continuously from 6 million in 1960 to reach 16 million in 2020, tying with Healthcare for the highest number of jobs.
Agriculture dropped from 6 million in 1960 to 3 million in 1980, remaining the smallest sector through 2020 at 2 million.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
